jamal: Config-only canary tonight 23:00-01:00 UTC. Tweaks: routing policy weights to favor cheaper region, reduce batch_size 64 -> 32 for latency-sensitive lanes, timeout 3s -> 5s for long-tail GP2 models. Plan: staged canary 5% (10m) -> 25% (15m) -> 100% (15m). Need +1 from oncall and product. :rocket:

maria: quick q — expected p95 change? any SLA risk?

alex: p95 should drop for small prompt brokers due to smaller batch. For high-throughput customers cost ~+2% (flagged in cost dashboard). We'll pin model-version=v1.4 for canary to avoid kernel variance.

sre-oncall: @jamal add rollback steps and confirm drainback is enabled.

jamal: rollback plan: 1) disable routing rule, 2) revert batch_size, 3) set canary traffic back to previous percentages. Trigger: latency > 2000ms for >5min at 25% or error rate > 1%. Posting commands below.

deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] config-only rollout queued by jamal -> env: prod-canary -> start: 2026-03-20T23:00:00Z -> id: cfg-3923456789

anya: paste the exact commands pls

jamal: ```bash
# rollback snippet
redwoodctl routing set-weight --rule-id=cheap-region --weight=0
redwoodctl config apply --file=configs/canary-batch-32.json --dry-run=false
redwoodctl traffic set --route=canary --percent=0
```

maria: can we run a smoke eval (100 prompts) after each step? :eyes:

jamal: yes — smoke eval after each stage. Thresholds: p95 < 1200ms and p99 < 2200ms. Fail -> immediate rollback.

alex: added a fallback model-variant (v1.4-int8) in routing policy to avoid OOM on some nodes. Automatic fallback on OOM enabled.

deploy-bot: [status] step1(5%) started at 2026-03-20T23:00:00Z

sre-oncall: observing infra now, charts look clean, no spikes so far.

maria: any product-visible change or feature flags to flip?

jamal: product handled UI flag, nothing user-visible.

deploy-bot: [status] step1 complete -> metrics ok -> promoted to 25% at 2026-03-20T23:10:00Z

sre-oncall: p95 rose ~150ms but within threshold, continuing.

jamal: reminder: config applied via config service only (no code). version pinned: model=v1.4, kernel=auto.

anya: +1

maria: +1 from product

deploy-bot: [status] rollout complete -> 100% at 2026-03-20T23:40:45Z :thumbsup:

jamal: nice. Post-deploy: monitor cost dashboard next 24h for upticks, and eval regression sets. Reopen thread if anything odd.

sre-oncall: will add alert suppressions for the change window and keep a close eye.

alex: release note added: "Config-only: adjusted routing weights, batch_size 64->32 for latency lanes, extended timeouts; pinned model v1.4; fallback variant v1.4-int8; staged rollout completed." Docs: https://docs.internal/redwood/releases/3923456789
